description_zh: 查询微服务的服务列表
name: ListAppServices

parameters.help_en: The application ID. Specify exactly one of the following parameters: `VpcId`, `NamespaceId`, or `AppId`
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，vpcId、命名空间ID、应用ID必须且只能填写一项
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The service type. Valid values:

dubbo

springCloud

hsf

k8sService
parameters.help_zh:
服务类型。取值说明如下：

dubbo
springCloud
hsf
k8sService
parameters.name: service_type

parameters.help_en:
The service registry type. Valid values:

0: SAE Nacos

1: self-managed service registry

2: MSE Nacos

9: SAE K8s Service
parameters.help_zh:
注册中心类型。取值：

0：SAE Nacos
1：自建注册中心
2：MSE Nacos
9：SAE K8s Service
parameters.name: registry_type

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of MSE Nacos. This parameter is required if the service registry is MSE Nacos
parameters.help_zh: MseNacos实例ID，当注册中心为MSE Nacos时必填
parameters.name: nacos_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The namespace ID of MSE Nacos. This parameter is required if the service registry is MSE Nacos
parameters.help_zh: MseNacos 命名空间ID，当注册中心为MSE Nacos时必填
parameters.name: nacos_namespace_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC. Specify exactly one of the following parameters: `VpcId`, `NamespaceId`, or `AppId`
parameters.help_zh: VPC唯一标识，vpcId、命名空间ID、应用ID必须且只能填写一项
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The namespace ID. Specify exactly one of the following parameters: `VpcId`, `NamespaceId`, or `AppId`
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间ID，VpcId、命名空间ID、应用ID必须且只能填写一项
parameters.name: namespace_id
